component.name: Input Method for COSMIC
COSMIC 輸入法
component.summary: Cangjie, Quick and RIME input for the COSMIC desktop
COSMIC 桌面的倉頡、速成及 RIME 輸入法

description.p: A native Wayland input method for COSMIC, made for Hong Kong users. Type Traditional Chinese with Cangjie (倉頡) or Quick (速成) through libcangjie2, smart Pinyin or Shuangpin through libpinyin, or use any RIME schema — Cangjie, Quick, Jyutping, Pinyin and more — through librime.
為 COSMIC 桌面而設的原生 Wayland 輸入法，以香港用戶為本。可用 libcangjie2 輸入倉頡或速成，亦可透過 librime 使用任何 RIME 方案，包括倉頡、速成、粵拼及拼音。

ul.li: Candidate window that follows the COSMIC theme and display scaling
Switch Chinese and English with COSMIC's own input-source switcher (Super+Space)
Works in COSMIC and GTK applications without IBus or Fcitx
Settings apply immediately, no restart needed

screenshot.caption: Cangjie candidates in COSMIC Text Editor

description.p: Builds on Launchpad for Pop!_OS / Ubuntu 24.04; AppStream metadata.
First release: Cangjie/Quick via libcangjie2, RIME via librime, candidate popup, settings app.
